title: Efficient Key Recovery for 6 or More Rounds of AES
summary: A new 5-round secret-key distinguisher is proposed, but whether it can yield an efficient key-recovery attack for 6 or more AES rounds remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For AES, given the proposed new 5-round secret-key distinguisher, determine whether an efficient key-recovery attack can be constructed for 6 or more rounds by exploiting that distinguisher or a modified version of it.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of the AES block cipher using secret-key distinguishers.
parameters: 5-round secret-key distinguisher, the proposed source technique
6 or more rounds, the target round range
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether an efficient key-recovery attack can be constructed for 6 or more rounds using the proposed distinguisher or a modified version of it.

citations.label: A New Structural-Differential Property of 5-Round AES

progress.summary: The source presents this as an explicit further-extension question. It asks whether the proposed 5-round secret-key distinguisher, or a modification of it, can support efficient key-recovery attacks beyond 5 rounds.
citation_labels: Lorenzo Grassi et al., A New Structural-Differential Property of 5-Round AES
